unrelated_plugins.scope: Only the package.json metadata named by receipt dependencies; no unrelated package code or configuration was read.

runtime_evidence.prompt_hash_rule: Independent recomputation as UTF-8 text, CRLF to LF, then outer whitespace trim, matching build.mjs prompt provenance semantics; raw file hashes are separately retained in full-tree checks.

guard_report_cross_binding.scope: Independent real model-stream -> run_code -> nested-tool pre-execute/monotonic guard. Baseline direct native API conformance calls below do not prove this guard.

limits: This verifies a filesystem snapshot, receipt hashes and explicitly whitelisted metadata, not live UI behavior or a runtime success claim.
Unrelated plugin preservation is established only at the receipt package-name and package.json metadata level, not each unrelated plugin's full tree.
Skill preservation compares all original UTF-8 text outside the inserted hook, preserving original line endings; UTF-8 BOM presence is separately recorded.
Before-state evidence is verified against saved backup bytes and receipts; the reviewer did not observe the installation action itself.
No credential file, original session or original E project was read. No UI, installation, receipt, source or configuration was changed. The only reviewer output is this JSON.

Frozen runtime report result statuses and their 10/9 check outcomes were read and their provenance independently rehashed. The reviewer did not observe or rerun the original runtime processes and did not inspect raw sessions.
Both reports exercise the current installed plugin bytes in isolated test Hosts. They do not establish activation or available capacity in the user's running desktop Host.

The native fixture copies prompt hashes from installed provenance. This review independently recomputes all 13 source prompt canonical hashes, but does not claim a separate digest readback of every effective runtime-composed prompt.
The guard report covers the actual PTC pre-execute guard path; controlled direct native API conformance checks in the main report alone do not prove that guard.
Fixtures use deterministic LLM outputs; these passes do not establish autonomous model quality, scientific validity or competition outcomes. They do not certify OS sandbox isolation.

The metadata probe records an OpenAlex fallback search rate limit and a public Crossref/DOI crosscheck. This is not a full-text or human literature verification and does not prove an optional literature MCP is mounted.
portable_derivation: Personal paths and isolated-session identifiers anonymized. Original local record is unchanged; this derivation does not create a review or run.
